issues.region: right panel (mixtape cards + Add place/Share row)
issues.problem: Whole stack below the title sits ~1px higher than the reference: Amazon card spans ~y94-154 in build vs ~95-155 in reference; same 1px upward shift on Central Africa, Indian Ocean, Add place and Share (text baselines 114/184/254/325 vs 115/185/255/326). Diff shows solid red outlines on all card edges and doubled text.
issues.fix: Add 1px to the gap between the mixtape title and the first card (e.g. margin-top +1px on the list container) so the first card top lands at y=95.

issues.problem: Diff shows filled yellow blocks on most waveform bars (x~650-865), not just edges: bar heights/vertical positions differ by ~1-2px from reference; the played/unplayed bars around the red playhead (x~864) also differ.
issues.fix: Match bar heights to the Figma values exactly and vertically centre bars on y=812; check bar width 6px / gap 4px.

issues.problem: The faded future bars (x~1320-1415) show full-height diff strokes: opacity/colour of the dimmed bars and the selected 2019 bar outline differ slightly from reference (build appears slightly lighter/less saturated).
issues.fix: Set dimmed bars to the Figma fill/opacity (approx rgba(200,230,110,0.45)) and verify the selected bar is 14x28px with 2px dark border at x=1300.

issues.problem: '2019' label and the arrow pair are offset ~1px (label x~1330 vs 1329; arrows at x~1385/1408 vs 1386/1409; label baseline ~1px higher).
issues.fix: Nudge the right-aligned header group: label +1px down / -1px left, arrows +1px right (check gap and right padding = 24px).

issues.problem: Grey dotted segment from pin 2 to pin 3 shows red dot-by-dot misregistration along its whole length (~1-2px), and the sailboat icon at ~(979,573) is offset ~1-2px.
issues.fix: Use the exact Figma path d-attribute and stroke-dasharray/dashoffset for the second leg; position boat with the Figma x/y (translate -50%,-50% on the path point).

issues.problem: Plane at ~(605,437) shows a red outline in the diff indicating ~1px offset/rotation difference versus reference.
issues.fix: Match the Figma position and rotation of the plane (check transform-origin center and rotation angle).

issues.problem: Search placeholder text sits ~1px lower/right (baseline y~49 vs 48) and the VOLUME label is ~1px right (x~507 vs 506).
issues.fix: Reduce search input padding-top by 1px (or set line-height to match Figma); reduce VOLUME label left offset by 1px.

notes: Very close reproduction: every element is present, text content, fonts, colours and icons all match, and the 0.89% pixel diff is at the anti-aliasing floor. The remaining differences are all sub-2px: a systematic 1px upward shift of the mixtape card stack, minor waveform and dimmed year-bar discrepancies, and slight misregistration of the second route leg and vehicle icons. Nothing a user would notice without an overlay, but they are consistently locatable in the diff.
